candidate_state: planned from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only and separately recorded in-house HalfKP checks
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, the optional opening-book feature, release and trainer Python tests, a native material-only USI smoke, WebAssembly native tests, release package generation, and generated JavaScript contract checks passed. CORR_W_NP=32 passed its paired material-only gate and was directionally positive in capped one- and four-thread checks with an in-house HalfKP network. IncrementUsePercent=75 passed its one-thread paired material-only gate and was positive but not SPRT-decisive in the latest four-thread run. No general playing-strength claim is made.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.66.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
The in-house HalfKP checks of CORR_W_NP=32 were positive at one and four threads but reached their game caps before the preregistered SPRT acceptance boundary.
IncrementUsePercent=75 passed its one-thread gate; the latest four-thread run was positive but did not cross its paired SPRT boundary, while an earlier four-thread run was neutral.
The separately stored nn_r2 checkpoint beat nn_r1 by 261-1-218 in 480 local games, but is not bundled and was not measured directly against material evaluation for this release.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
The local Chrome WebDriver session could not be created; the hosted WebAssembly browser test remains a required release check.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
